predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Paris Saint Germain vs Lorient: Expected Goals (xG), Wing Absences & Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Paris Saint Germain's territorial compression and set-piece superiority support a controlled Home Win alongside Under 2.5 goals and BTTS No against Lorient's low-volume attack.
